connect.title: Connect GitHub to review pull requests
connect.body: Reviews use the installed GitHub App: choose the repositories in Integrations.

repo.description: Every new commit on a pull request is scanned and compared with the main branch, so only what the pull request introduces counts. Its findings join the repository's status and are marked fixed automatically when a later commit removes them or the pull request is closed without merging.
repo.post_comment: Comment and set the commit status on GitHub
repo.branch: Rescan the main branch when it changes
repo.admin_only: Only an administrator can change these settings.
repo.enable_hint: Turn it on with its switch in the list so every push gets reviewed automatically, or use "Review now" on a pull request.
repo.branch_scanned: Main branch: last scanned after a change on {{date}} (commit {{sha}}). After a merge, the repository status catches up on its own, at most once every {{minutes}} min.
repo.branch_pending: Main branch: it will be scanned on the watcher's next pass. After a merge, the repository status catches up on its own, at most once every {{minutes}} min.
repo.missing_write: The installed GitHub App can't comment yet: it needs write access to Pull requests and Commit statuses. Reviews still run and show up here; once the installation accepts those permissions, they'll be posted on GitHub.

list.title: Open pull requests
list.empty: No open pull requests in this repository.

watch.title: Watched repositories · {{total}}
watch.description: Enabled repositories review every new pull request or push automatically and rescan the main branch when it changes (checked every {{minutes}} min).
watch.admin_hint: Turn them on one by one or in bulk.
watch.member_hint: Only an administrator can change what's watched.
watch.confirm_all: Watch every repository in the GitHub App? Each push to any of them will trigger a review.
watch.partial: Partial results: this account's repository list is still being read from GitHub.
watch.branch_current: main branch kept up to date
